The '''MDD-12 datapad''' was a model of [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] produced by [[MerenData/Legends|MerenData]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and programmed with business information, such as [[Currency/Legends|currency]] conversion tables or data uplink granting the user information on all goods traded in the region.<ref name="Far Horizons" />
